Interface FormOptions

public sealed interface FormOptions
How AsyncRequestBody.form(FormOptions) reads a form. 
body.form(FormOptions.defaults().withRawValues())
    .thenApply(form -> form.getString("path")); // "a%2Fb" for path=a%2Fb

  • Method Details

    • defaults

      static FormOptions defaults()
      Returns:
      The options of AsyncRequestBody.form(): the values are decoded

    • withRawValues

      FormOptions withRawValues()
      Options that keep the values of the fields of an application/x-www-form-urlencoded form as they appear in the body, not percent-decoded, e.g. a%2Fb, a + that is not turned into a space, and the percent-encoded bytes of a non-ASCII value: what a framework needs for a field it must not decode, e.g. a JAX-RS @Encoded form parameter. The names of the fields are decoded. A multipart/form-data form has no percent-encoding: it is read as with the defaults.
      Returns:
      The options with raw values

    • rawValues

      boolean rawValues()
      Returns:
      Whether the values of an application/x-www-form-urlencoded form are kept as they appear in the body, see withRawValues()
